edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and disputes between them arising out of or relating to the matters alleged in the Action.
edits.name: Recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount agreed by the parties in writing (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors, and assigns from all claims that were asserted or could have been asserted in the Action arising from the facts alleged therein.
edits.name: Release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed except to the parties’ legal, tax, accounting, insurance, and financial advisors; as required by law, court order, or regulatory authority; or as necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is entered into solely to compromise disputed claims and is not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party.
edits.name: No Admission

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of Four Hundred Twenty-Five Thousand Dollars ($425,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) within five (5) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement, by wire transfer pursuant to written wire instructions provided by Plaintiff’s counsel. Plaintiff shall file, or cause to be filed, a dismissal with prejudice of the Action only after Plaintiff’s counsel confirms receipt of cleared funds for the full Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Payment revised to specify amount, timing, wire, and dismissal after cleared funds

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of cleared funds for the full Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant and its past and present officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors, and assigns from all claims that were asserted or could have been asserted in the Action arising from the facts alleged therein.
edits.name: Release conditioned on cleared funds

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed except to the parties’ legal, tax, accounting, insurance, and financial advisors; to Plaintiff’s spouse and immediate family, provided they are informed of the confidential nature of the information; as reasonably necessary for tax, accounting, financial-planning, or estate-planning purposes; as required by law, court order, subpoena, or regulatory authority; or as necessary to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Confidentiality carve-outs added

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is entered into solely to compromise disputed claims and is not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party.
edits.name: No admission unchanged

edits.text: 5. NO DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree that they shall not make, publish, or communicate to any person or entity any false or disparaging statement concerning the other party, or concerning Defendant’s past or present officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors, or assigns, regarding the Action or the matters resolved by this Agreement. Nothing in this section prohibits truthful statements required by law, court order, subpoena, or regulatory authority.
edits.name: No-disparagement clause added

edits.text: 6. ENFORCEMENT; PREVAILING-PARTY FEES. In any action or proceeding to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement, in addition to any other relief available at law or in equity.
edits.name: Prevailing-party enforcement fees added
